title: #62 Exam Schedule
prompt: Some schools schedule all the exams at the end of each year, while other schools schedule them throughout the whole year. What are the advantages and disadvantages of these two strategies? Which one do you think is better?

promptSegments.text: Some schools schedule all the exams at the end of each year, while other schools schedule them throughout the whole year.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of these two strategies?
Which one do you think is better?

requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: End-of-year exams allow students to prepare all subjects together.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: End-of-year exams allow students to prepare all subjects together.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Spreading exams out helps students learn material in small parts and reduces stress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spreading exams out helps students learn material in small parts and reduces stress.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Scheduling all exams at the end of the year allows students to focus their study time on a few subjects, helping them feel prepared for the final exam.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Scheduling all exams at the end of the year allows students to focus their study time on a few subjects, helping them feel prepared for the final exam.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Scheduling exams throughout the year helps students learn material in small steps, reducing stress before the final day.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Scheduling exams throughout the year helps students learn material in small steps, reducing stress before the final day.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first strategy, concentrating all exams at the end of the year, allows students a long period for deep, focused preparation.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first strategy, concentrating all exams at the end of the year, allows students a long period for deep, focused preparation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second strategy, spreading exams throughout the year, helps maintain a consistent learning pace and reduces overall student stress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second strategy, spreading exams throughout the year, helps maintain a consistent learning pace and reduces overall student stress.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Concentrating all exams at the end of the year allows students ample time to create detailed study plans and prepare deeply for all subjects, reducing feelings of being rushed.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Concentrating all exams at the end of the year allows students ample time to create detailed study plans and prepare deeply for all subjects, reducing feelings of being rushed.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Spreading exams throughout the year ensures students are tested on material as they learn it, requiring continuous review and maintaining a steady level of knowledge and skill.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spreading exams throughout the year ensures students are tested on material as they learn it, requiring continuous review and maintaining a steady level of knowledge and skill.

modelPlan.focus: Compare and contrast the two exam scheduling strategies, evaluating their impact on academic performance and student well-being.
keyArguments: End-of-year exams allow for concentrated study periods and better retention but may cause stress and burnout.
Year-round exams distribute the workload, reducing stress but may lead to fragmented learning.
